name: INTA
recent: Inta Bina Group Berhad 近期出现董事与主要股东在闭市期内的连续交易申报，包括董事局主席 Dr Lim Pang Kiam 及董事经理 Mr Lim Ooi Joo 通过 Apexjaya Industries Sdn Bhd 增持股份。同时，公司因员工认股权计划（ESOS）行使而发行新股，涉及 60,000 股及 73,000 股，新股将于 2026 年 11 月 18 日上市。近期没有重要合约或业务公告。
notable: 董事局主席 Dr Lim Pang Kiam 于 2026 年 11 月 16 日以每股约 RM0.370 及 RM0.365 增持公司股份。
董事经理 Mr Lim Ooi Joo 通过 Apexjaya Industries Sdn Bhd 于 2026 年 11 月 10 日至 13 日期间多次增持公司股份。
公司因 ESOS 行使而发行新股，共 133,000 股，新股将于 2026 年 11 月 18 日上市。
risks: 董事及主要股东在闭市期内进行交易，需留意后续股权变动披露。
ESOS 新股发行导致股本小幅增加，可能产生轻微摊薄效应。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，公司营收为 RM180.5 million，环比下降 12.2%，同比下降 3.0%；净利为 RM10.36 million，环比下降 4.2%，同比增长 7.2%；净利率为 5.7%，高于上一季度的 5.3%。

recent_en: Inta Bina Group Berhad recently saw a series of director and substantial shareholder dealings during the closed period, including acquisitions by Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dr Lim Pang Kiam and Managing Director Mr Lim Ooi Joo via Apexjaya Industries Sdn Bhd. The company also issued new shares under its Employees' Share Option Scheme (ESOS) for 60,000 and 73,000 shares, with listing date on 18 Nov 2026. There were no major contract or business announcements recently.
notable_en: Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dr Lim Pang Kiam acquired shares at approximately RM0.370 and RM0.365 per share on 16 Nov 2026.
Managing Director Mr Lim Ooi Joo acquired shares through Apexjaya Industries Sdn Bhd on multiple occasions between 10 and 13 Nov 2026.
The company issued 133,000 new shares under the ESOS, with listing date on 18 Nov 2026.
risks_en: Directors and substantial shareholders traded during the closed period; further disclosure of shareholding changes should be monitored.
The ESOS new share issuance slightly increases share capital and may have a minor dilutive effect.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM180.5 million, down 12.2% QoQ and 3.0% YoY; net income was RM10.36 million, down 4.2% QoQ but up 7.2% YoY; net margin was 5.7%, higher than 5.3% in the previous quarter.
